statement: Let F : (C3 × ∆, {0} × ∆) → (C, 0) be holomorphic. Suppose that, for every t ∈ ∆, ft(0) = 0, ft has an isolated critical point at 0, and µ(ft, 0) = µ(f0, 0). After shrinking the disk and the germ representatives, there is a homeomorphism germ Φ(x, t) = (ϕt(x), t), ϕt(0) = 0, ϕ0 = id, ft ϕt(x)  = f0(x). Both Φ and Φ−1 are jointly continuous on neighborhoods of the origin section over the original disk.
